tools.name: deck_now_playing
tools.title: What plays in Deck
tools.description: What plays in Deck, the user's Spotify player: running (false and nothing else when Deck isn't running), playing (false when paused), the track's title, artist and album, track_uri and album_uri, position_ms and duration_ms, liked (null when likes aren't available), queued (the track came from the queue), the queue (each track's uri, title, artist, duration_ms, album_uri), the genre radio playing (genre, name) and Deck's latest error. Makes no request to Spotify. Use it before changing what plays, and to answer what's playing.

tools.name: deck_search
tools.title: Search Spotify in Deck
tools.description: Searches Spotify through Deck: artists (id, name), albums (uri, name, artist, year…) and songs (uri, name, artist, duration_ms, and its album). Each call is a request to Spotify, which blocks Deck for hours after too many: search once with good words (artist and album), not in a loop. Then deck_play_album or deck_play_song with the uris.

query.title: Search
query.description: An artist, an album or a song, e.g. "Destroyer Kaputt"

tools.name: deck_album
tools.title: An album's tracks
tools.description: An album and its tracks (uri, name, artist, duration_ms) from Spotify through Deck, by its spotify:album: uri. Use it to play or queue one song of an album (deck_play_song, deck_queue_song need the track's uri and the album's). One request to Spotify.

tools.name: deck_artist_albums
tools.title: An artist's albums
tools.description: An artist's albums from Spotify through Deck, by the artist's id from deck_search. One request to Spotify.

tools.name: deck_play_album
tools.title: Play an album in Deck
tools.description: Plays a whole album in Deck from its first track (Deck's player starts if it isn't running), in place of what plays; the queue stays. Returns what then plays. The user can undo it, back to what played before, where it was.

tools.name: deck_play_song
tools.title: Play a song in Deck
tools.description: Plays a song in Deck, and its album on from it (Deck plays whole albums). Needs the track's uri and its album's (from deck_search or deck_album). Returns what then plays. The user can undo it, back to what played before.

tools.name: deck_queue_album
tools.title: Queue an album in Deck
tools.description: Adds an album's tracks to the end of Deck's queue, which plays before the album or radio goes on. Returns the queue's length. The user can undo it.

tools.name: deck_queue_song
tools.title: Queue a song in Deck
tools.description: Adds one song to the end of Deck's queue. Needs the track's uri and its album's. Returns the queue's length. The user can undo it.

tools.name: deck_genres
tools.title: Deck's genre radios
tools.description: The genre radios Deck can play (deck_radio): each one's id, name and the artists it starts from, own true for one the user added. Makes no request to Spotify.

tools.name: deck_radio
tools.title: Play a genre radio in Deck
tools.description: Plays a genre's radio in Deck (Deck's player starts if it isn't running), in place of what plays: endless tracks in that genre, e.g. for "play some synthwave". The genre's id from deck_genres. Returns what then plays. The user can undo it, back to what played before, where it was.

genre.title: Genre
genre.description: The genre's id from deck_genres, e.g. synthwave

tools.name: deck_control
tools.title: Play, pause or skip in Deck
tools.description: Plays or pauses Deck, or goes to the next or previous track. Deck must be running (deck_now_playing says). Returns what then plays. The user can undo it.

tools.name: deck_like
tools.title: Like what plays in Deck
tools.description: Likes the track that plays in Deck (it goes in the user's Liked Songs on Spotify), or with liked false takes the like away. Nothing changes if it already is so. The user can undo it.

liked.title: Liked
liked.description: true to like, false to unlike

tools.name: deck_pick
tools.title: Pick for me in Deck
tools.description: Deck's Pick for me: plays an album from the user's shelf, their Curated list (albums recommended for them) or either, one not played in a while. Returns what then plays. The user can undo it.
